guard/30334.htm.text: Guard Babenco: The region of Gludio was the center of battle in the war with Gracia. After the Gracian army withdrew, the lord began an active restoration project, and we are recovering much of its former beauty, but there are still open wounds of war like the Ruins of Agony.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30334-1.htm.text: Guard Babenco: It was a village that was reduced to ashes by the Ol Mahum soldiers during the war with Gracia.
